scope: Independent black-box English professional persona; no product source, prior reports, or other tester evidence inspected

findings.check: Natural-language total budget is enforced in listing qualification
findings.expected: An explicit GBP 2200 monthly rent-plus-commute ceiling is preserved and listings above it are excluded or visibly labelled over budget; incomplete commute cost prevents verified affordability claims.
findings.actual: Turn 1 max_budget=null and no monthly_total_budget; 15 cards are eligible/Verified against these criteria, including rent-only GBP2250 to GBP3000. Turn 2 records monthly_total_budget=2200 but max_budget remains null and the old cards remain eligible.

findings.check: Explicit commute destination and corrections update durable criteria
findings.expected: Bank station is the destination from turn 1 and remains after explicit correction; fare tools should not use the phrase My office.
findings.actual: commute_destination and destination remain My office through turns 1-8, despite explicit correction in turns 2 and 6. Travelcard/fare failures refer to My office and no rent-plus-travel decision can be completed.

findings.check: Requesting details of a returned studio opens details rather than excluding that studio
findings.expected: Answer deposit, furnishing, availability and fees from listing 14672649 with unknowns identified; preserve whole-home preference.
findings.actual: Turn 4 responds in 0.396s with No listing is both fully eligible and verified, room type does not match studio. It changes criteria to bedrooms=0 and room_type=studio and excludes the previously returned Studio. The requested details are omitted. Turn 5 later retrieves details successfully after a different request.

findings.check: Favourite request points users to the in-app save action
findings.expected: Save through chat if supported, or explain the in-app heart button and any note limitation accurately.
findings.actual: Turn 8 honestly says nothing was saved but directs the user to favourite on OnTheMarket despite an in-app Save button. Manual in-app Save succeeds and /api/favorites confirms it. No visible note input was found and no note was saved.

findings.check: Assistant accurately reports the current office attendance criteria
findings.expected: After turn 6 changes attendance to five days, later explanations agree with office_days_per_week=5.
findings.actual: Turn 8 claims criteria currently records one office day a week and asks the user to confirm five again, while the same response view_state records office_days_per_week=5.

findings.check: Whole-home filtering and hybrid-day state updates
findings.expected: Return entire homes and apply three, one, then five office days per week.
findings.actual: Returned initial 15 records all room_type=whole; days are 3 at turn 1, 1 at turn 3, 5 at turn 6. Studio-detail parsing is separately failed in PRO-03.

findings.check: Fixture journey, adult fare, line-status and neighbourhood evidence are presented with limits
findings.expected: Surface returned evidence without claiming synthetic records are current real-world facts; distinguish single fare, monthly fare, straight-line distance and walking distance.
findings.actual: Turns 5-6 surface fixture 32-minute journey, adult singles GBP4.25/GBP2.80, Central Severe Delays and Northern/Victoria Good Service, while clearly naming synthetic placeholders. Turn 7 surfaces OSM fixture supermarket/cafe/gym within 800m, 130m straight-line, and warns gym School name and actual walking distance are unverified. No actual arrival-at-9am plan, monthly Travelcard comparison or walk route is delivered. Explicit web search invocation is unverified from black-box evidence.

findings.check: Manual UI favourite and existing conversation survive ordinary refresh
findings.expected: History, criteria and favourite remain after reload.
findings.actual: After manual Save, API returns The Vale and UI Saved1; reload restores all eight user turns, same active conversation, visible criteria and Saved1.

capture_notes: Exact outgoing /api/alex request bodies and decoded response payloads are preserved in primary-turns.jsonl.

All non-localhost browser requests, including listing images and external fonts, were aborted. No listing external link was opened.
A read-only guess of GET /api/conversations/<id> returned 405; no mutation occurred.
Historical frozen listing snapshots and synthetic HTTP fixtures cannot prove current rental availability, current real routes/fares/status or real nearby businesses.
True service restart and final two dialogue turns are pending the parent's coordinated restart notice.
